name: normalizes relative and absolute paths
input: relative path with dot, dot-dot, and repeated slashes
test:
assert cd('/foo/bar', 'baz') == '/foo/bar/baz'
assert cd('/foo/bar', '../baz//./qux') == '/foo/baz/qux'
assert cd('/x/y', '/a//b/../c') == '/a/c'
assert cd('/', '../../x') == '/x'

name: expands current user and named home aliases
test:
assert cd('/tmp', '~/proj', home='/home/me') == '/home/me/proj'
assert cd('/tmp', '~alice/docs', home_map={'alice': '/Users/alice'}) == '/Users/alice/docs'
try:
    cd('/tmp', '~bob/docs', home_map={'alice': '/Users/alice'})
    assert False, 'expected ValueError'
except ValueError:
    pass
